description: This file implements a process management system with functionalities to start, stop, and check the status of system processes. It defines the DefaultProcessManager class and its methods, utilizing os/exec and syscall packages.

classes.name: DefaultProcessManager
classes.description: A struct that manages system processes, tracking running processes and providing methods to start, stop, and check their status.

methods.name: NewProcessManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of DefaultProcessManager with an initialized process tracking map.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a new process based on the provided configuration, redirects logs if specified, and tracks the process by PID.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Terminates a process by PID, attempting graceful shutdown first, then forceful kill if needed, and cleans up tracking.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and command information of a process by PID, checking if it is still running.
